Delivered · 2026-11-17T15:56Z · PR #34852 merged (aa5a7d0b), and its `Fixes` line closed this card. On a slotted record page, the `discussion` slot's record:chatter feed inside the bordered side rail now has the same inner padding and border tone as record:activity's peek face. RecordChatterPanel reads `RecordTimelinePanelContext` and passes `border-border px-3 py-3`, so the feed no longer runs flush to the rail's border. Outside the rail panel the feed is unchanged. L1's two notes went to the filer as epic note 16 on #34571: the authored left/right discussion position, and the card's two headings. `pm:dispatched` is removed.
